newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DISCIPLINARY SITUATION IN EUROPEAN COMPETITIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DISCIPLINARY SITUATION IN EUROPEAN COMPETITIONS.

text.p: The following list shows players with yellow cards going into this week's European Champions League quarter-finals as well as those players suspended from playing in all three European club competitions.
European Champions League quarterfinals first leg
